title: InterviewEvaluationResult
description: JSON Schema chuan dau ra cho he thong danh gia cau tra loi phong van bang AI LLM (Gemini 3.6 Flash)

session_id.description: UUID dinh danh duy nhat cua phien phong van (VARCHAR 36)

question_id.description: ID cua cau hoi trong bang questions MySQL

question_order.description: Thu tu cau hoi trong phien phong van (vi du: cau 1, 2, 3)

scores.description: Diem so chi tiet cho 3 tieu chi danh gia doc lap

chuyen_mon.description: Do chinh xac ve mat chuyen mon ky thuat (Trong so: 50%)

ro_rang.description: Do mach lac, cau truc trinh bay va dien dat (Trong so: 30%)

chieu_sau.description: Chieu sau kien thuc, vi du code thuc te va kha nang phong tranh loi (Trong so: 20%)

total_score.description: Diem tong ket theo cong thuc BR-04: round(chuyen_mon * 0.5 + ro_rang * 0.3 + chieu_sau * 0.2, 1)

feedback.description: Danh gia va nhan xet dinh tinh bang tieng Viet

strength.description: Diem manh noi bat cua cau tra loi

weakness.description: Nhung diem con thieu sot hoac chua chinh xac

suggestion.description: Loi khuyen cu the giup ung vien cai thien va nang cao kien thuc

evaluation_level.description: Xep loai tong the dua tren total_score (EXCELLENT >= 8.5, GOOD >= 7.0, AVERAGE >= 5.0, WEAK >= 3.0, FAIL < 3.0)
